Keep all four G findings bounded and preserve the comparator defects. No human/native role/model/cost/generalized superiority claims. Keep actual tool/command evidence and exact view returns. Return your complete final acceptance text and report/declaration paths, including rejection/unresolved scope if that is your judgment.
